swing_ideas.text: Great flag action happening at ATHs. So long as pullbacks remain over the 296 level thinking about upside continuation.

Despite hearing about folks mentioning "Vegas is dead" the stock is far from it. Looking at this flag over prior highs is interesting for continuation into 64 should it hold over 58. Nice initiating gap on earnings, now time to see if it can follow through after consolidating near the highs.
